create_inverse_sqrt_scheduler: create an inverse square root learning rate scheduler with warmup phase and inverse sqrt decay
configure_warmup_updates: configure warmup updates and initial learning rate arguments for the inverse sqrt scheduler
step_scheduler_epoch: step the inverse sqrt scheduler at epoch boundaries to return the current learning rate
step_scheduler_update: step the inverse sqrt scheduler after each update to compute and set the new learning rate
register_inverse_sqrt_scheduler: register the inverse square root scheduler as a fairseq learning rate scheduler plugin
